Step card header

Source: R/steps.R
kit_step_head.Rd

Three states:

Usage

kit_step_head(
  k,
  title,
  state = c("current", "done", "locked"),
  summary = NULL,
  edit_id = NULL,
  title_id = NULL
)

Arguments

k

The step number.

title

The title of this step.

state

"current", "done", or "locked".

summary

A one-sentence summary shown when done (for example "5 個檔案 · 世代 TDCYP · 2009、2011（年）", "5 files · cohort TDCYP · 2009, 2011 (year)"). Not shown for the current step; a step not yet available always shows "先完成第 N−1 步" ("Finish step N−1 first").

edit_id

The actionLink() id for "改" ("Edit") when done; NULL hides "改".

title_id

The id of the title (pass it to the title_id of kit_step_card()).

Value

<div class="kit-stephead is-current"> or similar.

Details

  • "current": the current step, a lime round number, aria-current="step".

  • "done": finished, a round ✓ (mint green), followed by a one-sentence summary, with "改" ("Edit") at the far right (when edit_id is given).

  • "locked": not yet available, gray, showing "先完成第 N−1 步" ("Finish step N−1 first").

Next to the number there is text for screen readers: "第 N 步，現在這一步：" ("Step N, current step:").

Examples

kit_step_head(1, "每個檔案是哪個世代、哪個波次", "done",
              summary = "5 個檔案 · 世代 TDCYP", edit_id = "edit1")
#> <div class="kit-stephead is-done">
#>   <span class="kit-stepnum" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>
#>   <span class="visually-hidden">第 1 步，做完了：</span>
#>   <span class="kit-steptitle">每個檔案是哪個世代、哪個波次</span>
#>   <span class="kit-stepsum">5 個檔案 · 世代 TDCYP</span>
#>   <a aria-label="改第 1 步：每個檔案是哪個世代、哪個波次" class="action-button action-link kit-stepedit" href="#" id="edit1"><span class="action-label">改</span></a>
#> </div>
kit_step_head(2, "哪些欄是題目", "locked")
#> <div class="kit-stephead is-locked">
#>   <span class="kit-stepnum" aria-hidden="true">2</span>
#>   <span class="visually-hidden">第 2 步，還不能做：</span>
#>   <span class="kit-steptitle">哪些欄是題目</span>
#>   <span class="kit-stepsum">先完成第 1 步</span>
#> </div>
